name: state-of-mind
title: State of Mind
description: One State of Mind as Apple records it: whether it was a moment or a day, how pleasant it was, the feelings the person named and what they associated with them. Every field is optional. The valence is kept as the person gave it and is not drawn.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: A moment's emotion or the day's mood.

valence.title: Valence
valence.description: How pleasant, from -1 (very unpleasant) to 1 (very pleasant), as the person set it. It carries no bounds, because bounds would draw a scale.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: HealthKit's name for how pleasant it was.

labels.title: Feelings
labels.description: The feelings the person named, in HealthKit's words.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: What the person linked the feeling to, in HealthKit's words.

start.title: Start
start.description: When it was logged, ISO 8601 with its offset from UTC.
